items.title_en: Best Tools for Gut Health & Weight Loss | Dr. Chris Thompson
items.title_cn: Best Tools for Gut Health & Weight Loss | Dr. Chris Thompson
items.desc_en: Dr. Chris Thompson, MD, Professor of Medicine at Harvard Medical School, Chief of Interventional Gastroenterology at Mass General Brigham in Boston, and Co-Director of the Center for Weight Management and Wellness, is a world-renowned expert on gastroenterology, metabolism, nutrition, and obesity medicine. He explains how your GI tract regulates hunger, fullness, and blood sugar, as well as the gut microbiome, metabolic health, and weight loss. We also discuss common GI tract issues and which particular tests or interventions are actually useful. We discuss both GLP-1 medications and non-GLP-1

items.title_en: Essentials: How to Assess & Improve All Aspects of Your Fitness | Dr. Andy Galpin
items.title_cn: Essentials: How to Assess & Improve All Aspects of Your Fitness | Dr. Andy Galpin
items.desc_en:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Andy Galpin, PhD, an exercise physiologist. We revisit the first episode of his Huberman Lab Guest Series to discuss the nine major components of physical fitness and how to assess your abilities. We explain practical tests for movement quality, power, strength, muscle mass and endurance, including grip strength, push-ups and VO2 max. We also discuss how to organize fitness testing, track progress and identify which areas to prioritize in your training to support long-term health and performance.

Show notes: https://go.hubermanlab.com/7

items.title_en: The Art of True Happiness | Dr. Arthur Brooks
items.title_cn: The Art of True Happiness | Dr. Arthur Brooks
items.desc_en:
Dr. Arthur Brooks, PhD, professor at Vanderbilt University and senior fellow at Harvard Business School, is an expert on the science of happiness. He shares the three “macronutrients” of true happiness and tools for you to understand what specifically is in the way of you accessing more happiness and a sense of purpose. Dr. Brooks’ work goes beyond stories and observations by offering potent self-discovery tools for you to identify what truly matters most to you and how to shape your life around those things, and doing so, experience more joy and fulfillment. 

Show notes: https://go.hubermanl
